items.title: Maduro pleads not guilty to new torture-related charges in New York
items.summary: "I reject this document entirely," Maduro said in court, responding to newly added torture-related charges.

items.title: Russia accuses Ukraine of attacking oil refinery after Zelensky says strikes to resume
items.summary: Ukraine's president says a pause on striking energy sites is over following fresh Russian attacks.
